title: hear.ingest.batch.v1
description: DAMA Hear HTTPS batch ingest request frame, major version 1. Normative wire codec is UTF-8 JSON (application/vnd.dama.hear.ingest.batch.v1+json). The frame major versions the framing only; each item carries its own schema_version. Readers MUST accept unknown properties within this major, MUST refuse an unsupported batch_schema_version before reading any item, and MUST refuse a single malformed item without refusing the batch.

batch_schema_version.description: Frame major version. Unsupported majors are refused before any item is read.

batch_id.description: Producer-chosen batch identity, stable across retries of the same batch. Used for receipt correlation and log joins, never for deduplication.

device_id.description: Submitting producer. Cross-checked against the credential; a mismatch is refused, never overwritten from the body.

sent_at.description: RFC3339 UTC instant the producer handed the batch to the transport, or null when it has no usable clock. Never used as an observation time.

items.description: One hear.ingest.v1 envelope, or a legacy telemetry body during the mixed-version window. Items are not constrained by this schema: the item contract is https://schemas.dama.example/hear/ingest/v1/envelope.schema.json and a legacy body is translated by the edge adapter, not by the frame reader.

messages.description: Items in producer order: hear.ingest.v1 envelopes, or legacy telemetry bodies during the mixed-version window. Order is preserved; it is not identity.

boot_id.description: Producer boot identity; a change means batch sequences are not comparable.

boot_epoch_us.description: Producer boot epoch in microseconds UTC.

batch_sequence.description: Monotonic per-boot batch counter. Gap detection evidence only.

spool_backlog.description: Items still spooled at the producer after this batch. Backpressure input.

producer.description: Optional continuity evidence for the batch itself. Absent means the producer exposes no boot/sequence, not that continuity is fine.

adapter.description: Submitting adapter identity when a gateway, drain or import tool submits on a producer's behalf. Absent for a device submitting directly.
